integrity: Exact analytic and finite-enumeration proof with reproducing cyclotomic checker; finite calculations do not establish the infinite theorem without the published prime bound.
scientific_limitations: p is prime at least five; only the monomial graph (x,x^4) over Z/p²; no full nonzero eigenvalue spectrum.
Relies on the published Masuda–Zieve prime-field binomial nonexistence bound plus finite explicit checks at p=5,7,11,13.
Classical stationary phase and possibly equivalent quartic exponential-sum formulas are prior foundations; independent review not performed.
title: A prime-seven Fourier-null anomaly for quartic graphs over prime-square rings
